activePlan.objective: Add a reusable two-phase AI-link bootstrap for future repositories that creates Development-branch and applies governance only after the workflows are verified on main.
steps: Extend the human-dispatched AI link with separate install and activate phases.
Require main as the default branch, create Development-branch during installation, and install the mandatory AI governance files without activating required checks.
Before activation, verify the installed workflows on main and verify their exact check names on a representative pull request.
Apply zero-bypass rulesets through an explicitly supplied administration token, while preserving the rule that development is the only writable AI branch.
Add regression tests and documentation, run the complete verification set, and push only to development.

completed: Confirmed the current link is repository-local, human-dispatched, and presently installs files only.
Selected a two-phase design so required checks cannot be enabled before their workflows exist on main and have reported on a representative pull request.
Implemented installation of the mandatory AI governance files and safe creation of Development-branch without replacing an existing branch.
Implemented fail-closed activation with exact owner confirmation, a repository-scoped Administration token, representative pull-request check verification, and zero-bypass rulesets.
verification: Workflow permissions lint, documentation consistency, configuration validation, AI conflict governance, clutter, privacy, security, and git diff validation pass.
remaining: Push the verified commit only to development and confirm hosted Self-Test and CodeQL. Adoption remains per-repository unless a separate template or organization provisioning service places the link into future repositories.
